A 416 and a 304 carry public Cache-Control and ETag, as the contract requires. C's own probe (cache416-1440.json): in Chromium 143, a default-cache plain GET after a 416 went to the server and got 200 with 5,760,044 bytes, so the browser cache was not poisoned. A later 206 and plain GET were served from the browser cache (0 server lines). Shared or CDN caches are not measurable here; worth one row in the post-deploy list.
